validated_contract.capability: one vendor capability requires cfg_type=VIRTIO_PCI_CAP_NOTIFY_CFG, valid BAR index, aligned non-zero offset, length at least 0x14, and non-zero notify_off_multiplier
validated_contract.address_policy: queue zero notification offset is read from the common page; multiplier/addition overflow checks and capability-window checks produce one scalar notification_paddr
validated_contract.common_state: 0 -> ACKNOWLEDGE -> ACKNOWLEDGE|DRIVER -> ACKNOWLEDGE|DRIVER|FEATURES_OK -> ACKNOWLEDGE|DRIVER|FEATURES_OK|DRIVER_OK -> queue_select=0/read notification offset -> 0
validated_contract.mapping: only the prevalidated common-config page is temporarily root-mapped; notification BAR is not framed or mapped; common reservation and frame are released on every return
validated_contract.authority: no copied capability, notification mapping/write, driver domain, queue layout frame, queue enable/address write, IRQ, PCI-command write, bus-mastering write, IOSpace/DMA authority or containment claim
